patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with a dark, semi-transparent overlay for text contrast, setting a dramatic and sophisticated tone.
Large, bold, dark sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy against lighter body text.
A high-contrast color palette featuring dark charcoal/black, crisp white, and a vibrant, unexpected yellow accent for the contact section.
The hero background image parallaxes, moving slower than the foreground text content as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.
Sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and alternating background colors, providing a clean and organized content flow.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image uses a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text readability against a dramatic landscape photograph, with the background image moving at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a parallax scrolling effect.
A sticky header maintains the brand logo and navigation access at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, without changing size or background.
Content sections are introduced with a staggered fade-up animation as they scroll into view, leveraging a library like AOS (Animate On Scroll) to enhance engagement and guide the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, impactful headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with a clean, readable body text. Uppercase labels are used for section pre-headings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on input fields and buttons, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, dark-toned cinematic hero with a subtle parallax effect, which immediately conveys a sense of gravitas and vision. This is effectively contrasted with bold, clean typography and an unexpected, high-contrast vibrant yellow contact section, creating a sophisticated yet approachable feel.
